annotations.title: Set the priority pages and services

description: Sets the pages that matter most on one of the organization's websites and the services they sell, inside the plan's limits. Findings on a priority page rank higher. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.

pages.description: One page per line, an address or a path, optionally followed by ' | service'; the set becomes exactly these.

services.description: One service the website sells per line; the set becomes exactly these.
